invariants.text: Models propose. Code decides. No LLM vote is verification.
promotion_allowed stays false unless an owner amendment receipt exists.
Light must not import Heavy, FEP, personality, or spinor as geometry.
Solver-chosen obs__* are not bound observation rows.
Prompt corpus and output corpus stay apart.
Failure is its own full wave. Falsification is deduction.
Induction keeps an antichain. Do not pick a winner here.
The latest prompt is a proposal against the ledger, never canon by default.
Rejected branches and why they failed stay searchable and binding.
